query: read_parquet('/data/atlas/cube/variable=*/*.parquet', hive_partitioning = true) reads them all; naming one variable's directory reads only that file.

columns.basin_id: HYBAS level-12 identifier, a string because it is an identifier
columns.variable: the store's attribute id; resolve a concept through the registry
columns.value: null where there was no observation, never zero
columns.unit: the physical unit of the value, as measured

registry.note: One preferred product per concept, chosen once and in the open. A fallback is named where a second source could answer, and naming it as a fallback says it is not the preferred answer.

uz:aet-monthly-v1.aggregation: area-weighted mean of the monthly field
uz:aet-monthly-v1.why: Published on the same grid and water balance as precipitation and potential evapotranspiration, so the three can be differenced without crossing models.

uz:pet-monthly-v1.aggregation: area-weighted mean of the monthly field
uz:pet-monthly-v1.why: Paired with actual evapotranspiration from one model, which is what makes their ratio a moisture index rather than a comparison of two conventions.

uz:pre-monthly-v1.aggregation: area-weighted mean of the monthly field
uz:pre-monthly-v1.why: Downscaled to about four kilometres, which matters where a level-12 basin sits in mountain terrain and a coarse cell would average a valley with a ridge.
uz:pre-monthly-v1.fallback_cost: About eleven kilometres, so a headwater basin may hold a single cell.

uz:run-monthly-v1.aggregation: area-weighted mean of the monthly field
uz:run-monthly-v1.why: TerraClimate publishes no runoff. This is a land-surface flux and is not discharge: it has not been routed and no gauge has been compared to it.

uz:snw-monthly-v1.aggregation: frequency of snow-covered days in the month
uz:snw-monthly-v1.why: Daily observations aggregated here, rather than the monthly product the atlas cites, so the count of contributing days is known per basin and month.
uz:snw-monthly-v1.caution: Its gaps grow towards the present at constant source coverage, so the series is published for inspection and withdrawn from trend analysis.

uz:soil-monthly-v1.aggregation: area-weighted mean of the monthly field
uz:soil-monthly-v1.why: A modelled column store in millimetres. It is published as what it is and not relabelled as the percentage the atlas attribute holds.

uz:tmn-monthly-v1.aggregation: area-weighted mean of the monthly field
uz:tmn-monthly-v1.why: The month's daily minima, paired with the maxima from the same model.

uz:tmp-monthly-v1.aggregation: area-weighted mean of the monthly field
uz:tmp-monthly-v1.why: A true mean of hourly values. TerraClimate publishes only the daily extremes, and their midpoint is a different measurement that happens to carry the same name.
uz:tmp-monthly-v1.fallback_cost: Finer at about four kilometres, but a midpoint of extremes rather than a mean of hours, and about a degree warmer across this region.

uz:tmx-monthly-v1.aggregation: area-weighted mean of the monthly field
uz:tmx-monthly-v1.why: The month's daily maxima. ERA5-Land publishes no daily extreme on this grid.

unavailable.discharge: No gauged or modelled discharge series is published; runoff is a land-surface flux and is not the same quantity.
unavailable.drought index: Not an observation. SPI is derived on demand from published precipitation by products.spi(), with the gamma fit stated; SPEI would additionally need a water balance and is not offered.
unavailable.land surface temperature: Air temperature is published; land surface temperature is not, and the two are different measurements.
unavailable.ndvi: No vegetation index is published as a regional dated series.
unavailable.surface water: Published as a long-term climatology, not as a dated monthly series.
unavailable.vapour pressure deficit: Not derived. It would need humidity, which is not published.
unavailable.vegetation: No NDVI or EVI series is published. Nothing here substitutes for it.

reading.scope: Local basin support only. Upstream values accumulate everything draining through a basin and cannot be summed across basins, so they are not here: a cube inviting that sum would be a trap.
reading.evidence: This is a read path, not the record. It carries no revisions, run ids, coverage counts or missing reasons. Cite the store release named above, not this file.
reading.nulls: A null is a month with no observation. It is never a zero, and nothing downstream may coalesce it into one.
reading.query: Readable in place by anything that speaks Parquet. Over a host serving byte ranges, a browser can query it without downloading it.
